result.rationale: The diff adds refreshOAuthTokens.ts which calls fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, {...}) with no AbortSignal/timeout. This fetch replaces the direct provider refresh calls on hot paths (Google/Office365/Zoom/Lark CalendarService refreshAccessToken invoked during booking requests), so a hanging sync endpoint would stall token refreshes. This is a specific, grounded robustness/operability concern introduced by the diff, but not a demonstrable correctness defect since behavior is correct when the endpoint responds.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts lines 6-14, the fetch call to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT has no timeout/deadline configured. If the sync endpoint is slow or unavailable, this fetch will hang indefinitely, blocking the OAuth refresh flow. This is a real defect - network calls should have timeouts to prevent indefinite blocking. The diff clearly shows a bare fetch() with no AbortController or timeout mechanism.
